info.name: Download payslip in the PDF format

items.docs:
Given a Payslip ID, downloads a payslip.
It is important to note that each country has a different payslip format and they are not authored by Remote.


## Scopes

| Category | Read only Scope | Write only Scope (read access implicit) |
|---|---|---|
| Manage employment documents (`employment_documents`) | View payslips (`payslip:read`) | - |

params.name: start_date
params.description: Filters by payslips `issued_at` field, after or on the same day than the given date

params.name: end_date
params.description: Filters by payslips `issued_at` field, before or or the same day than the given date

params.name: expected_payout_start_date
params.description: Filters by payslips `expected_payout_date` field, after or on the same day than the given date

params.name: expected_payout_end_date
params.description: Filters by payslips `expected_payout_date` field, before or or the same day than the given date

params.name: page_size
params.description: Change the amount of records returned per page, defaults to 20, limited to 100
